mapper.sql: select id, source_code, source_name, source_type, current_version_id, owner_dept_id, confidentiality, allowed_purpose, allowed_role_ids, enabled, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from business_knowledge
mapper.select: where id=#{id}
where source_code=#{sourceCode} limit 1
mapper.update: update business_knowledge set current_version_id=#{versionId},status='2',remark=#{remark},update_time=sysdate() where id=#{sourceId} and (current_version_id is null or current_version_id<#{versionId})
mapper.delete: delete from business_knowledge where id in #{id}
mapper.select: select * from business_kb_version where id=#{id}
select * from business_kb_version where source_id=#{sourceId} and content_sha256=#{contentSha256} limit 1
select * from business_kb_version where source_id=#{sourceId} order by id desc
select * from business_kb_ingest_task where id=#{id}
select * from business_kb_ingest_task where version_id=#{versionId} order by id desc limit 1

select c.*,s.source_name,s.source_type,v.version_no,v.original_name, (match(c.title_path,c.content) against(#{query} in natural language mode)
+ case when lower(c.content) like concat('%',lower(#{term}),'%') then 100 else 0 end
+ case when replace(replace(replace(lower(c.content),'-',''),' ',''),'–','') like concat('%',#{normalizedLiteral},'%') then 30 else 0 end ) score from business_kb_chunk c join business_knowledge s on s.id=c.source_id and s.enabled='1' and s.current_version_id=c.version_id join business_kb_version v on v.id=c.version_id and v.status='2' where (match(c.title_path,c.content) against(#{query} in natural language mode)
or replace(replace(replace(lower(c.content),'-',''),' ',''),'–','') like concat('%',#{normalizedLiteral},'%') )
and lower(c.content) like concat('%',lower(#{term}),'%')
and s.source_type=#{sourceType}
and (s.allowed_role_ids is null or s.allowed_role_ids='' or find_in_set(#{roleId},s.allowed_role_ids)>0)
order by score desc,c.id asc limit #{limit}

select c.*,s.source_name,s.source_type,v.version_no,v.original_name from business_kb_chunk c join business_knowledge s on s.id=c.source_id and s.enabled='1' and s.current_version_id=c.version_id and s.source_type='REPORT' join business_kb_version v on v.id=c.version_id and v.status='2' where c.metric_id is not null and c.metric_id<>''
and replace(replace(replace(lower(concat(c.metric_id,' ',coalesce(c.title_path,''),' ',c.content)),'-',''),'_',''),' ','') like concat('%',lower(#{term}),'%')
and (s.allowed_role_ids is null or s.allowed_role_ids='' or find_in_set(#{roleId},s.allowed_role_ids)>0)
order by c.id desc limit #{limit}

select c.*,s.source_name,s.source_type,v.version_no,v.original_name from business_kb_chunk c join business_knowledge s on s.id=c.source_id and s.enabled='1' and s.current_version_id=c.version_id join business_kb_version v on v.id=c.version_id and v.status='2' where c.version_id=#{versionId} and c.metric_id=#{metricId} and c.title_path=#{titlePath} order by c.chunk_no asc

select c.*,s.source_name,s.source_type,v.version_no,v.original_name from business_kb_chunk c join business_knowledge s on s.id=c.source_id join business_kb_version v on v.id=c.version_id where c.version_id=#{versionId} order by c.chunk_no asc

select c.*,s.source_name,s.source_type,v.version_no,v.original_name from business_kb_chunk c join business_knowledge s on s.id=c.source_id and s.enabled='1' join business_kb_version v on v.id=c.version_id and v.status='2' where c.id=#{id}
and (s.allowed_role_ids is null or s.allowed_role_ids='' or find_in_set(#{roleId},s.allowed_role_ids)>0)
mapper.insert: insert into business_kb_entity (entity_key,entity_name,entity_type,aliases,create_time,update_time) values (#{entityKey},#{entityName},#{entityType},#{aliases},sysdate(),sysdate()) on duplicate key update id=last_insert_id(id),entity_name=values(entity_name),aliases=values(aliases),update_time=sysdate()
mapper.sql: select r.id relationId,r.relation_type relationType,r.period,r.data_type dataType,r.source_id sourceId,r.chunk_id chunkId, r.evidence_snippet evidenceSnippet,r.evidence_start startOffset,r.evidence_end endOffset, f.id fromId,f.entity_name fromName,f.entity_type fromType, t.id toId,t.entity_name toName,t.entity_type toType, s.id sourceId,s.source_name sourceName,v.version_no versionNo,v.original_name originalName, c.page_start pageStart,c.page_end pageEnd,c.source_url sourceUrl from business_kb_relation r join business_kb_entity f on f.id=r.from_entity_id join business_kb_entity t on t.id=r.to_entity_id join business_kb_chunk c on c.id=r.chunk_id join business_knowledge s on s.id=r.source_id and s.enabled='1' join business_kb_version v on v.id=r.version_id and v.status='2'
mapper.select: select c.*,s.source_name,s.source_type,v.version_no,v.original_name from business_kb_chunk c join business_knowledge s on s.id=c.source_id and s.enabled='1' and s.current_version_id=c.version_id join business_kb_version v on v.id=c.version_id and v.status='2' order by c.version_id,c.chunk_no limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into business_kb_qa_session (task_id,task_owner,question,source_type,include_news,status,progress,current_stage,error_message,snapshot_json,create_time,update_time) values (#{taskId},#{owner},#{question},#{sourceType},#{includeNews},'QUEUED',0,'等待执行','',#{snapshotJson},sysdate(),sysdate())
mapper.select: select task_id taskId,task_owner owner,snapshot_json snapshotJson from business_kb_qa_session where task_id=#{taskId}
mapper.delete: delete c from business_kb_qa_citation c join business_kb_qa_session s on s.task_id=c.task_id where s.finished_time is not null and s.finished_time<#{cutoff}
delete c from business_kb_qa_claim c join business_kb_qa_session s on s.task_id=c.task_id where s.finished_time is not null and s.finished_time<#{cutoff}
delete from business_kb_qa_session where finished_time is not null and finished_time<#{cutoff}
